courses.overview: This course provides foundational knowledge about the principles of artificial intelligence (AI) and how it is used in educational settings. It includes a comprehensive exploration into AI principles, an introductory module on leveraging the potential of AI for trainers, a practical exploration of AI applications, and activities for incorporating AI into teaching and learning. By taking this course, you will develop an understanding of various types of AI systems and their practical applications. You will also learn how to enhance your training programs with AI. Additionally, you will gain valuable insights from real-world examples of AI in action and examine how AI can enhance educational processes.

courses.overview:
This Content Creation for Green Skills course aims to empower young individuals with the skills and knowledge to explore the fundamentals of content creation with a focus on green skills. The course emphasizes creating and distributing impactful content as an essential green skill, highlighting how eco-conscious storytelling and digital media can inspire sustainable action and address environmental challenges effectively. 

This online course was developed by Ms. Sochenda Aok, a 5-year experienced environmental content creator from Cambodia who founded ZEROW, a green media platform to empower youth to adopt a sustainable lifestyle. Sochenda is a Forbes 30 Under 30 and an ASEAN Youth Eco-Champions Awardee.

courses.title: Become an Entrepreneur
courses.short_description: In Module 1, you’ll shift your focus from chasing big ideas to deeply understanding real problems—starting with empathy, curiosity, and your own lived experiences. You’ll learn how to define a meaningful problem, reflect on your personal values and strengths, and lay a strong foundation for building a venture that’s not only innovative, but deeply rooted in what matters most.

courses.short_description: Module 0 sets the stage for your confident speaking journey by exploring why communication is the #1 skill for career and personal growth.
